title: Distinct agent identities with provenance on every action
objective: Each agent run has a unique identity separate from humans; actions record agent, model, prompt version, tool, principal and delegation chain.
implementing_systems: Unbound evidence envelope (runtime; designed, not built)
notes: Implemented for engineering provenance in repositories using Praxis; not for runtime.

title: Delegation without authority amplification
objective: Sub-agent delegation passes only a subset of the delegator's authority, records the chain and expires with the run.

title: Authority matrix with deny-by-default for agents
objective: Every command is mapped per actor type and authority level; unmapped commands are refused; agents in release 1 are limited to A2 reversible internal actions.
notes: 2026-11-25 refinement-agent: framework_refs: Replaced superseded SRC-OWASP-LLM-TOP10-2025 with SRC-OWASP-LLM-TOP10-2026; locators remapped to 2026 numbering (LLM06:2025 to LLM03:2026).

title: No self-grant and out-of-authority request reporting
objective: Agents cannot change their own permissions or policy; repeated rejected requests are rate-limited and reported to the agent owner, never escalated to a decision.

title: Reserved human authority enforced by the engine (NoAiClearance)
objective: Commands that approve, release, change payees, instruct trades or clear risk concerns accept only authorized human actors or board-delegated deterministic rules; agent actor types are rejected.
notes: EDF invariant: AI never clears under NoAiClearance; agents never hold human-authority operations.

title: Approval bound to proposal and evidence hash with segregation
objective: Approvals reference a hash of the exact proposal and evidence; material change invalidates approval; approver differs from preparer; initiator cannot attest independent reconciliation.

title: Delegation governance and anti-rubber-stamp sampling
objective: Deterministic delegations are board-recorded with limits and expiry and reported quarterly; risk-stratified samples of human and delegated approvals are independently reviewed.

title: Agent emergency stop and tested safe mode
objective: Authorized humans can suspend agents individually or globally; queued actions suspend safely; deterministic paths continue; resumption requires approval; stop is tested on schedule.

title: Decision record and replayable decision package
objective: Each consequential decision stores accountable actor, evidence snapshot, AI contribution with versions, policy version and outcome, renderable as a reproducible package.
implementing_systems: Folio (exists; not operated for this purpose)

title: Evidence produced only by deterministic systems; agents cannot write evidence
objective: Evidence stores accept writes only from deterministic evidence producers; agents have no write or delete path to evidence or logs; attempts are denied and alerted.

title: Labeled AI summaries and production versus test evidence separation
objective: AI summaries of evidence are labeled, linked to source records and not accepted alone; synthetic and test evidence is labeled and stored apart; wrong summaries are withdrawn with dependents flagged.

title: Machine-checked honesty of answer library
objective: Answer units carry controlled status; the build rejects customer statements that assert current capability without an implemented status and flags independent-assurance claims without verification.

title: Named human signatory for released questionnaire responses
objective: No questionnaire response leaves Echelon without review and sign-off by a named accountable human, recorded with the answer unit versions released.

title: Human approval required to merge, release or deploy agent-authored changes
objective: Protected branches and release pipelines require approval by an authorized human who did not prompt the change; two such approvers for control-relevant modules; agents cannot approve.

title: No standing or break-glass production access for agents
objective: Agents hold no standing production credentials or emergency access; scoped read diagnostics require pre-approval; writes require per-case human approval.
